reason: A valid import-free root package containing a single string concatenation passes plain Go 1.26.6 tests but reproducibly panics in pinned Orchestrion OnCompile when a synthetic propagation import is assigned to its nil PackageFile map; adding a real import makes the woven build pass. Go 1.27.0 stops earlier on a separate encoding/json advice error.
